positions.name: SluglessSubmissionHandling
positions.frame: how does the pipeline handle a memory submitted without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the submission arrived without an explicit id field; src-2 directs that the pipeline must generate a slug from memory content — via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback — and commit the file. Together they cohere under the question of what happens when no id is supplied: the pipeline's slug-generation and commit path is the response.
